title: Benefit
wikitext:
'''Benefit''' is a [[special]] card similar to [[Blessing]].  Benefits bend the rules of the game slightly, giving [[investigator]]s new options.  Each Benefit has a certain event or situation described beneath the abilities it grants that ends the effect of the card.  If your investigator ever finds himself in that situation, he discards the Benefit. For instance, an investigator with the [[Psychic (benefit)|Psychic]] Benefit loses the card if he is ever [[Lost in Time and Space]].  If another investigator already has a Benefit that you are told to draw, you may take it from that investigator (this is no longer allowed in the Revised Edition).
